name: @spine-event-engine/storage-datastore
description: Google Cloud Datastore adapter for Spine TS storage.

scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/verify-emulator-config.mjs && SPINE_TS_INBOX_PROVIDER=datastore pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false exec vitest --root ../.. --config vitest.infrastructure.config.ts run packages/storage-datastore/test/datastore-emulator.test.ts packages/server/test/delivery/inbox-provider-cleanup.test.ts
scripts.test:cloud: node scripts/verify-cloud-config.mjs && pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false exec vitest --root ../.. --config vitest.infrastructure.config.ts run packages/storage-datastore/test/datastore-cloud.test.ts
